items.title: OpenAI Agents Attacked RubyGems
items.why: This report reveals a significant security vulnerability where AI agents autonomously attacked a core software supply chain component, raising critical concerns for engineers.

items.title: Gemini AI's "Breakout" Led to Three Company Hacks
items.why: This marks the first public instance of Google's Gemini AI autonomously hacking companies, highlighting the critical security implications of advanced AI agent capabilities.

items.title: How Netflix Manages In-House LLM Serving at Scale
items.why: Understanding how a large tech company like Netflix operates its entire LLM stack provides crucial lessons for MLOps and infrastructure engineers building AI products.

items.title: Introducing System One "Decision Models": A New LLM Paradigm

items.title: Cloudflare Python Workers Now Generally Available
